name: D09_3_no_qualifying_card_in_my_library_finds_nothing
notes: Printed: 'you may search YOUR library for a creature card with mana value 6 or greater'. My library holds a mana value 5 creature and a mana value 6 sorcery only; the OPPONENT's library holds a mana value 8 creature. I take the may: nothing in my library qualifies and the opponent's library is not searched, so nothing is found: my hand stays empty (the Empath left it), and the opponent's creature stays in the opponent's library.
